system:
Shared frozen semantic rules (both interfaces):
Only existing value/check/compose/atom/end nodes and const/ref/add/le/eq expressions. No executable code, callbacks, new meanings or external effects. Int64 is signed64, Bool distinct, Unit null. add/le require Int64; eq requires identical operand types. add overflow rejects OVERFLOW. check needs Bool, yields Unit; false rejects with its code at site's provenance. Failure absorbs all later operations. Each step executes once in submitted order; result evaluates after steps. Immutable bindings, exact types, no shadowing, forward references, cycles or free variables. Call arguments are only refs/literals, matching exact named signature; templates substitute expressions rather than eager call-by-value. Nested seq provenance/work preserved. UInt8 atom consumes one byte, end rejects trailing data. Host uses empty byte input and fixed UInt16BE output0..65535; no reads needed for these objectives. Bounds: max7 authored definitions+HostEntry;8 inputs/definition;32 steps/region;128 stored/package;depth8 expressions;max64 expanded VM nodes;nesting4;64KiB strict JSON. Target Int64 and exact requested input signature. No persistent mutable symbol registry. All authored definitions are validated. Names ASCII letter then letters/digits/underscore max32. HostEntry reserved. Cryptographic sealing is mechanical and shared by both tracks; no semantic repair. 

Use only native lykoi construction tools; declare typed inputs, append ordered operations, finalize each result, then validate_candidate. Expressions use scalar literals, $input_or_prior_alias, or [add|le|eq,operand,operand], one binary layer. Exact dependencies include every referenced input/local alias once. Limits3 definitions/4 inputs/8 operations per definition. Errors leave state unchanged. Stop on completed validation. No supplied library or solution. Maximum16 model turns/24 tool calls/3 correction turns. Do not access files, other tools or other sessions.
neutral: Call lykoi_declare_input with definition Neutral and inputs []. Then call lykoi_apply_operation with definition Neutral, alias n, operation value, type Int64, expression 4, dependencies []. These tools are inert; this tests schema visibility and ordered invocation only. Stop after both succeed.
calibration: Construct only OffsetTotal(a:Int64,b:Int64). Store the subtotal of a and b as an immutable Int64 value. In a second value step, increase that stored subtotal by the constant 3. Return the second stored value. Exactly two ordered value steps, with explicit dependencies. Use the native construction tools and finish with validate_candidate.

fresh.N1: Reserve(stock:Int64,credit:Int64): first store add(stock,credit), then store add of that prior subtotal and -7. Return the second stored value. Exactly two ordered value steps and one definition. The second step must depend on the first.
fresh.N2: Threshold(base:Int64,extra:Int64,ceiling:Int64): store add(base,extra) as Int64; store le of that stored subtotal and ceiling as Bool; check the stored Bool with code CEILING and site literal71; return the stored subtotal. Exactly value,value,check in this order and one definition.
fresh.N3: Gate(allowed:Bool,x:Int64,y:Int64): check allowed with code CLOSED and site literal73; then store Bool le(x,y); check that stored Bool with code ORDER and site literal79; then store add(x,11) and return it. Exactly check,value,check,value in this order and one definition. Earlier failure must absorb later checks/arithmetic.
fresh.N4: Reusable Lift(v:Int64): store add(v,5), return the stored value. Bundle(left:Int64,right:Int64,ceiling:Int64) must compose the SAME Lift first with left, then with right; store add of the two call results; check le of that stored total and ceiling with code BUNDLE and site literal83; return the stored total. Exactly two definitions, Lift[value], Bundle[compose,compose,value,check], no inlining.
